# Introduction

This is a template Quarto document with Material Design 3 styling.

## Example Mermaid Diagram

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 10
%%| fig-height: 6

flowchart LR
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Option 1]
    B -->|No| D[Option 2]
    C --> E[End]
    D --> E

    classDef primaryClass fill:#6366F1,stroke:#6366F1,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff
    classDef successClass fill:#10B981,stroke:#10B981,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff
    classDef warningClass fill:#F59E0B,stroke:#F59E0B,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff

    class A,E primaryClass
    class C successClass
    class D warningClass
```

## Color Palette

Use Material Design 3 colors:

- **Primary**: #6366F1 (Indigo)
- **Secondary**: #EC4899 (Pink)
- **Accent**: #10B981 (Green)
- **Warning**: #F59E0B (Amber)
- **Error**: #EF4444 (Red)
